title: Sleeps 18 • 8BR Home w/ Pool, Backyard & Smart TVs
description: Bring your group together at this spacious 8-bedroom home designed for family trips, sports teams, reunions, graduations, golf weekends, and group getaways. Enjoy a private pool, large backyard, outdoor grill, arcade game, smart TVs in every bedroom, fast Wi-Fi, and a fully equipped kitchen. Conveniently located near ASU, Tempe, Scottsdale, spring training stadiums, and Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport. Comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests.
amenities: Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability
Ryan's place was perfect for our family. It was everything you needed. We have a great time and a good recommended to anyone.

This is our 2nd time staying at Ryan's place.  We have been staying there every time we go watch the Dodgers play in AZ.  We love the place.  The kids love the pool and the backyard.  It has many bedrooms to fit us all.  We did doordash some groceries and love the kitchen set up where we all hung out to if we were not in the pool.

The house was everything we expected from Ryan's description, and was great for me and my team to stay.  The place was extremely clean and his response time to whatever questions we had was extremely fast.  We will be reaching out to Ryan in the future when working in this area, as he was a great host.
Good Value nice to not share small beds.

Amazing stay for our large group! The home was fully stocked with everything we needed and had plenty of space for everyone to relax comfortably. We had such a fun time enjoying the pool, and Ryan was incredibly responsive and helpful throughout our stay. Would definitely recommend for group trips and would love to come back!
Thank you so much Ryan!! We had a great stay and you were always a text away to help if needed! Will def book again!!
